what: the foot of a bridge of trembling rainbow-coloured light that rises out of the dark on the right and climbs away out of the top of the picture. On a block of pale stone at its foot stands a tall watchman seen from behind, in a long white robe and white cloak, his long white-blond hair down his back, looking up the bridge; in his raised right hand he holds up high against the rainbow one great dark curved horn, bent round in a deep half circle, bound with three bands of gold, its wide bell open to the sky.
colours: A bridge of soft rainbow light, red, gold, green and violet bands; a white robe and white cloak; white-blond hair; a dark brown-black horn with bright gold bands; pale grey stone; a deep blue-black dark.
must_show: a bridge of rainbow light climbing into the dark
a great curved dark horn with gold bands across his knees
a man in white seen from behind at its foot
one great dark curved horn held up high
three gold bands on the horn
note: Picked round 1, candidate 1. The horn across his knees was not drawn in any of three rounds (round 2: held at his side, round 3: slung on his back); the watchman at the foot of the bridge carries the badge.

what: a great rough grey boulder in a dark cave, seen close and low, sitting heavy on the cave floor. In the front of the picture, standing upright and leaning against the boulder, taller than the boulder itself, is one long knotted wooden staff of pale hawthorn wood with a pale grey stone held in the loop at its top. Beside them grows a small hawthorn white with flowers. A thin line of warm gold light glows out from under the boulder's lower edge, as if someone down there had a candle.
colours: Pale grey boulder with dark cracks and green moss; a hawthorn of dark brown branches, green leaves and white flowers; a dark brown knotted staff; a thin warm gold glow under the stone; a dark brown-black cave.
must_show: a flowering hawthorn beside it holding a staff
a thin line of warm light under the boulder's edge
one long knotted wooden staff standing upright in front
note: Picked candidate 1: the stone, the hawthorn and the light under it carry the badge; the staff in the branches was not drawn.
